posts.title: Interesting Things From Ages Long Ago
posts.description: I watch several YouTube channels from stores that sell retro games and people that play them. I was watching one such video and I had a thought. Video game preservation is important. We do not want old media to vanish. It is better for all of humanity that old stories be preserved, regardless of their format. But does anybody care? posts.title: My Cat and Her Cone
posts.description: Just a little background, my cat’s name is Squirt and she is thirteen years old. We adopted her ten years ago. My cat scratched the hell out of her head. It just wasn’t healing on its own so we took her to the vet. She got an antibiotic injection, topical ointment and an e-collar. My dog has had three surgeries, so we are used to e-collars. posts.title: WWE Trading Cards
posts.description: I watch WWE Raw and Smackdown every week. They’ve been advertising Topps trading cards all year long. The collector in me says, “That looks fun. I should buy some. My daughter, wife and I could have fun opening them up.” They’ve been sold out on the Topps website. I haven’t tried very hard to buy them anywhere else.
